source_differences: An earlier note on this record says the west tube is under reconstruction until end-2028, gov.si (sanacija 1. cevi) gives works March 2026 to approx. April 2029, and ic-group says full two-tube operation mid-2029.

An earlier note on this record says the old dataset point (46.45371, 13.99048) is consistent with being the east-tube portal. OSM does not support this: the open east-tube (new) way ends at 46.453011, 13.991006, about 88 m from the old point, the old point is about 75 m north of the OSM west-tube end.

Length of original tube: 7,864 m (en.wikipedia/wikiwand) vs 8,019 m (Lotsberg, wikiwand calls 8,019 m the enclosure between portals). Slovenian part: 3,450 m (Lotsberg, hr.wikipedia) for the original tube vs 3,546 m for the new east tube (DRI).

Structurae Karavanke road pages could not be opened (site error), so the current anchor 46.453408, 13.990164 attributed to Structurae was NOT re-verified, it lies about 44 m from the OSM west-tube portal end.
Length: the Wikipedia infobox gives 8,138 m, the mapped tubes measure 7,882 and 7,845 m.
Lay-bys of the original tube: 8 in each direction in the text of the regional plan against 7 in its summary table.
